column3: Ayase Route ・ Ayase's Date Arc
Kiririn-shi is very fortunate to have someone like Ayase-shi.
T-That's... not true... Ehehe...
Onii-san... Saori-san is quite a good person, despite being an otaku.
I know, right?
Though I hadn't expected things to turn out like this.
But that's true, having Ayase meet up with Saori is probably the best way for her to learn more about Kirino and her hobbies.
That being said, with Saori's help we might be able to change Ayase's view on all things otaku.
Thanks, Saori.
I have yet to do anything.
In any case, Ayase-shi, would you please allow me to lend a hand?
Eh?
Oh, great idea! What do you say, Ayase?
B-But...
I don't mean to brag but when it comes to Akiba, she's a lot more reliable than I am.
There should be no problems if we leave things to Saori.
You put a lot of faith in Saori-san.
Well, yeah.
Hehe.
Okay then! Saori-san, I'm counting on you!
Understood! Leave it to me!
As such, Saori started telling Ayase about all things otaku, using light and easy words.
I think... Operation Overcome Otaku-phobia might actually be progressing now.
Saori-san, thank you very much for today.
Thanks to you, I feel... that I've gotten a little closer to Kirino.
That's great.
That reminds me, Ayase-shi, why don't we take a commemorative photo in honor of today?
Ah, that's a good idea.
Saori, what are you plotting...?
Well then, Ayase-shi, over here...
Eh? Eh?
Hey now, where do you think you're taking her?
It's the changing room, Onii-chan. We have recently introduced a service where we let customers take commemorative cosplay photos～♪
Commemorative cosplay photos... It couldn't be...
...Wow.
W-What's with this... this outfit?!
Haha! It suits you well, Ayase-shi!
Amazing! Mistress, you're very cute!
T-That's... I haven't even worn things like this for work...
Well then, Mistress, I'm taking a picture now～!
Eh... E-Eh?!
Okay, say cheese♪
Truly a professional model. She reflexively poses as the camera is turned her way.
I guess... you might be able to call Ayase and Saori friends by now.
I wasn't sure what would happen if I brought her here.
But in the end, everything turned out fine.
Ufufu.
For one, I got to lay eyes on Ayase in a maid costume!
Could I take a photo as well?
No way! D-Don't look at me with your lewd eyes!
...Now then, I will excuse myself.
Okay.
Good job today.
No... You also helped me out a lot.
Well, all I really did was introduce you to Saori.
That's more than enough. It was a good opportunity.
After talking to her, what do you think about Saori?
She treated me kindly... She's a very good person.
I think I can understand why you trust Saori-san, and also why Kirino admires her.
It's just...
Just what?
I guess I still can't really understand Kirino's hobby.
While I think I've gotten a little closer... It's still not enough.
That so?
Well... Maybe I shouldn't say this, seeing as you're working so hard...
But there's really no need to rush, you know.
It's not like Kirino expects you to do this for her, right?
Not like she's going to accept that.
Um... Onii-san?
Hmm?
Could I... come to you for consultation again?
Sure, anytime.
Really? Then... I'll take you up on that.
Sure. I've come too far to turn back now. Besides, didn't I tell you before?
...I love you the most, after all.
Just kidding!
G-Goodbye!
...Huh?
That's different from her usual reaction.
It's not like I really want to be scolded by Ayase.
Still, that was rather disappointing.
What had I done?
At that time, I had no idea.
